name: Cleft
summary: The Cleft is a darkened hollow located northwest of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Once a tranquil corner of the boughs, it has been claimed by the corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs, who use it as a stronghold to ambush travelers moving along the main highway toward Darnassus.

sections.title: A Den of Corruption
sections.body: Situated off the highway between Dolanaar and Darnassus, the Cleft has turned into one of the most perilous dens on the world tree. Driven mad by the foul taint spreading through Teldrassil, the resident Gnarlpine furbolgs have fortified this subterranean rift under the command of their vicious chieftain, Ursal the Mauler. From this redoubt, the maddened beasts terrorize the local roads, capturing unvigilant night elves and threatening to cut Dolanaar off from the capital.

sections.title: The Roadway Ambushers
sections.body: The threat posed by the Cleft grew dire enough that Moon Priestess Amara and her sentinels were forced to establish a defensive watch along the road outside its entrance. The furbolgs within carried out brazen kidnappings, dragging slumbering night elf druids into the depths of the cave to perform dark rituals. Cleansing the Cleft and slaying Ursal is crucial for the Sentinels to secure the primary artery connecting Teldrassil's villages to Darnassus.

faq.answer: The Cleft is a furbolg den located in the boughs of Teldrassil, situated northwest of Dolanaar along the main road that leads toward Darnassus.
It is occupied by hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs who have fallen victim to Teldrassil's creeping corruption. Their local leader within the cavern is a powerful brute named Ursal the Mauler.

faq.q: Why are the night elves fighting here?
faq.answer: The Gnarlpine inside the Cleft have been ambushing travelers along the road to Darnassus. Worse, they kidnapped slumbering druids and held them captive inside the den, forcing Moon Priestess Amara and the Sentinels to intervene.

faq.q: Is the Cleft related to the Cleft of Shadow?
faq.answer: No. Despite having a similar name, this Cleft is a furbolg cave in Teldrassil, whereas the Cleft of Shadow is the dark subterranean cavern located inside the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

angles.text: The Cleft represents a painful tragedy for night elves, watching their longtime furbolg allies succumb to madness and capture sacred druids from their slumber.
The Gnarlpine inside the Cleft dared to abduct dreaming druids from their trances, turning a sacred restorative process into a dangerous trap.
